messages:
Maya (Product): Heads-up: Private/on-prem release v1.2 is rolling to GA next Tue 2026-04-07. Includes FIPS-compatible crypto mode, extended audit/log streaming for SOC2 evidence, and an improved offline installer for air-gapped installs. Docs + release notes: https://internal.redwood.ai/private/v1.2

Raj (Eng): Nice. Is there a migration path for existing private customers on v1.0?

Maya (Product): Yes — we built an automated migration script that preserves model pins and rollout policies. "private-upgrade.sh" in the release bundle. Short checklist in the docs under "Upgrade plan".

Elaine (Security): Key compliance notes: FIPS mode toggles libc crypto to the validated provider and enables additional key-wrap auditing. Customers using HSMs should confirm KMS provider compatibility; see the KMS matrix in the security doc.

Sam (Solutions): I'll open SE booking slots for migrations and proof-of-concepts. Can we publish an availability calendar link?

Maya (Product): Yes — calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/private-1-2-se. Also planning a customer webinar Thu 2026-04-02, 10am PT (recording will be posted).

Raj (Eng): Ops note for on-prem installers: new flag --fips-mode and --audit-endpoint. Example config snippet for air-gapped deploy: ```yaml
installer:
  offline: true
  enable_fips: true
  audit_sink: file:///var/log/redwood/audit.log
  model_cache_dir: /mnt/redwood/cache
```

Raj (Eng): Also: if customers enable FIPS, quantized kernels fall back to the non-AVX2 path on older nodes. Performance drop ~10-15% in our benchmarks — called out in the perf section.

Elaine (Security): Action item for SEs and PMs: include the SOC2-compatible audit checklist in all new contracts where Private is requested. I'll drop the checklist PDF into the docs page by EOD tomorrow.

Sam (Solutions): Got it. I'll update the customer readiness playbook and slot migration requests.

deploy-bot: Release bundle uploaded to internal-artifacts/private/v1.2 (sha256: 7f3a2c...). Verify checksum before distribution.

Maya (Product): TL;DR: GA next Tue, FIPS & SOC2 logging supported, migration script included, SE booking + webinar live. If you're owning customer migrations, please react with :thumbsup: and add any blocked customers to the spreadsheet: https://docs.redwood.ai/private-1-2-rollout

Raj (Eng): :thumbsup: will post upgrade runbook in #eng-oncall and pin it.

Sam (Solutions): :tada: I'll run the first customer dry-run next Monday and share notes.

Elaine (Security): Thanks everyone — ping me for any KMS edge cases.

Maya (Product): Thanks team — will follow up with a short announcement email for customers tomorrow.
